question: Natural rubber is soft at high temperatures and brittle at low temperatures; therefore, raw rubber is strengthened by heating it with sulfur and other additives at a temperature of 373-415 K. This process is called ______ of rubber.
solution:
The correct answer is __Vulcanization.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Vulcanization__ is a chemical process used to strengthen rubber.
 
• It involves heating raw rubber with sulfur and other additives at a temperature of 373-415 K.
 
• This process enhances the elasticity, durability, and strength of the rubber.
 
• Vulcanized rubber is less sticky and can withstand a wider range of temperatures.
 
• This technique is widely used in the manufacture of tires, seals, and hoses.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Latex:**

 
 
• Latex is a milky fluid produced by rubber trees.
 
• It is the raw material for natural rubber production.
 
 
 
• **Extrusion:**
 
 
• Extrusion is the process of shaping material by forcing it through a die.
 
• This technique is commonly used for plastic and rubber products.
 
 
 
• **Molding:**
 
 
• Molding involves shaping raw materials into desired forms using molds.
 
• It is used in the production of rubber goods, plastics, and metals.
